The database schema named "rschema_0266" contains three tables: "Pipeline", "Maintenance_Personnel", and "Maintenance_Activity_Record".
The "Pipeline" table represents the infrastructure of the pipeline system. It has four columns: "Diameter", "Ending_Point", "Pipeline_ID", and "Starting_Point". The "Diameter" column is of type FLOAT and represents the diameter of the pipeline. The "Ending_Point" and "Starting_Point" columns are of type VARCHAR(255) and represent the locations where the pipeline ends and starts, respectively. The "Pipeline_ID" column is of type INTEGER and serves as the primary key for this table.
The "Maintenance_Personnel" table represents the personnel involved in the maintenance of the pipeline system. It has three columns: "Maintenance_Personnel_ID", "Name", and "Phone". The "Maintenance_Personnel_ID" column is of type INTEGER and serves as the primary key for this table. The "Name" and "Phone" columns are of type VARCHAR(255) and represent the name and phone number of the personnel, respectively.
The "Maintenance_Activity_Record" table represents the records of maintenance activities performed on the pipeline system. It has five columns: "Maintenance_Details", "Maintenance_Personnel_ID", "Maintenance_Time", "Pipeline_ID", and "Maintenance_Activity_Record_ID". The "Maintenance_Details" column is of type VARCHAR(255) and represents the details of the maintenance activity. The "Maintenance_Personnel_ID" and "Pipeline_ID" columns are of type INTEGER and serve as foreign keys referencing the "Maintenance_Personnel_ID" and "Pipeline_ID" in the "Maintenance_Personnel" and "Pipeline" tables, respectively. The "Maintenance_Time" column is of type DATETIME and represents the time when the maintenance activity was performed. The "Maintenance_Activity_Record_ID" column is of type INTEGER and serves as the primary key for this table.
This schema ensures domain integrity by ensuring that the "Diameter" column in the "Pipeline" table cannot be null, and that the "Name" and "Phone" columns in the "Maintenance_Personnel" table cannot be null. It also ensures entity integrity by enforcing primary key constraints on the "Pipeline_ID", "Maintenance_Personnel_ID", and "Maintenance_Activity_Record_ID" columns in the "Maintenance_Activity_Record" table. The schema also enforces referential integrity by setting foreign key constraints on the "Maintenance_Personnel_ID" and "Pipeline_ID" columns in the "Maintenance_Activity_Record" table, ensuring that the values in these columns correspond to valid entries in the "Maintenance_Personnel" and "Pipeline" tables, respectively.
gold_question: The pipeline company manages multiple pipelines, each identified by a pipeline ID, starting point, ending point, length, and diameter. The company employs multiple maintenance personnel, and each maintenance task must record the pipeline ID, maintenance personnel, maintenance details, and maintenance time. The system shall support real-time monitoring of pipeline maintenance tasks and performance evaluation.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0266
CREATE TABLE `Pipeline` (
  `Pipeline_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Diameter` float NOT NULL,
  `Starting_Point` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Ending_Point` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Pipeline_ID`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Maintenance_Personnel` (
  `Maintenance_Personnel_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `Phone` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Maintenance_Personnel_ID`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Maintenance_Activity_Record` (
  `Maintenance_Activity_Record_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Maintenance_Details` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Maintenance_Time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `Maintenance_Personnel_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Pipeline_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Maintenance_Activity_Record_ID`),
  CONSTRAINT `Maintenance_Activity_Record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Maintenance_Personnel_ID`) REFERENCES `Maintenance_Personnel` (`Maintenance_Personnel_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `Maintenance_Activity_Record_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`Pipeline_ID`) REFERENCES `Pipeline` (`Pipeline_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
